mechanics.name: Shine Charges
mechanics.body: Shine Charges are an optional mechanic that accrue at the start of your turn equal to the Round number, but disappear at the end of combat. You can use these charges to empower or change the way Light spells work. *Unless otherwise stated, Shine Charges can be spent multiple times to amplify the given effect.*

mechanics.name: Blind
mechanics.body: A blinded creature makes Physical and Spell attack rolls with Disadvantage, has -2 to AC, and automatically fail AGI and DEX saves, or saves that directly require eyesight. Blind is a Weak Debuff and can last multiple turns.

spells.name: Shine Charges
spells.body: At the start of your turn gain a number of **Shine Charges** equal to how many **Rounds** have started. You have no maximum limit to Shine Charges but they are all removed at the end of combat. Shine Charges are used to enhance or manipulate the behaviour of various Light Spells. *Unless otherwise stated, Shine Charges can be spent multiple times to amplify the given effect.*

upgrades.text: Start combat with **1 Shine Charge**. This increases by **+1** per 15 Light CA and every 3 Player Levels.
Whenever you Respite, gain **2 Shine Charges**. This increases by **+1** per 10 Light CA.
Once per turn gain **2 Shine Charges** whenever you Blind a creature. Once per turn gain **3 Shine Charges** whenever you Crit with Radiant damage. *These are two different abilities.*
At the end of each turn where one of your a spells or abilities healed an ally, gain **1 Shine Charge** per 6 Health healed.

spells.name: Ray of Light
spells.body:
As a **Full Action** make a Ranged Spell Attack shooting a beam of concentrated light towards a a creature within **12m**, dealing **1d8** Radiant damage on hit. Damage increases by **+1d8** per 15 Light CA and every 4 Player Levels. Spend any number of **Shine Charges** to empower this spell:
- 1 Charge to add **+4m** of range to Ray of Light.
- 2 Charges to increases the damage Dice Tier Count by **+1**.

***0 Mana Cast:*** As a **Half Action** make a Ranged Spell Attack shooting a smaller beam of concentrated light towards a creature within **6m**, dealing **1d6** Radiant damage on hit. Damage increases by **+1d6**. The 0 Mana Cast cannot use Shine Charges to empower it.

upgrades.text: Spend **2 Shine Charges** to target an additional enemy within range or to have Ray of Light bounce from the original creature targeting another within **10m** of the last. You can 2 more Charges any number of times to increase the number of targets each, or the length of the chain. Make separate Attack rolls for each target.
If any target of Ray of Light is **Blinded** or is attacked with **Advantage**, gain **+4** to Crit.

spells.name: Enchant Weapon: Light
spells.body:
As a *Half Action* enchant your weapon for your next **3** attacks/spell casts. Gain the following effects while enchanted depending on the weapon type:

**Melee**: Full Attacks gain bonus **1d6** Flat Radiant damage on hit, while Half Attacks gain **1d4** instead. Damage Dice Tier Count increases by **+1** per 15 Light CA and every 4 Player Levels.

**Ranged**: Full Attacks gain bonus **1d6** Flat Radiant damage on hit, while Half Attacks gain **1d4** instead. Damage Dice Tier Count increases by **+1** per 15 Light CA and every 4 Player Levels.

**Spell Focus**: **+4m** to range of Light spells and all spells that deal Radiant damage. Spell Attack rolls gain **+2**, or **+1d6** if the target is Blinded.

upgrades.text: Martial Attacks while Enchanted that **miss** force the enemy to make a DEX save or become Blinded by 1 turn.
You can spend **3 Shine Charges** to increase the Radiant damage **Dice Tier Dice Tier** by **+1** from Enchanted Martial Attacks.
You can spend **1 Shine Charge** when casting a Radiant damage dealing spell while Enchanted to increase the damage **Dice Tier Count** by **+1** each.

spells.name: Healing Light
spells.body: As a **Full Action** choose a friendly creature within **3m**, they are healed for **1d6** Health. Healing is increased by **+1d6** per 20 Light CA and every 6 Player Levels. Spend **2 Shine Charges**, increase the healing **Dice Tier Count** by **+1** each. Spend **1 Shine Charge** to increase Healing Light’s range by **+3m**.

upgrades.text: Spend **2 Shine Charges** to cleanse the target, performing a **Minor Dispell** each time.
Spend **3 Shine Charges** to increase the healing **Dice Tier Dice Tier** by **+1** each time.

spells.name: Flashbang
spells.body:
As a **Full Action** choose a point within **8m** to conjure a brief but blinding flash of light. Each creature within a **4m** diameter AoE of that point makes a **DEX** Save or becomes **Blinded** for 1 turn. This spell also deals **2d6** Radiant damage to each creature on fail, or half on success. Damage increases by **+1d6** per 10 Light CA.

You may spend any number of Shine Charges to empower Flashbang:
- 2 Charges to increase the diameter by **+2m**.
- 1 Charge to increase the damage **Dice Tier Count** by **+1.**
- 3 Charges to increase the **Blind** duration by 1 turn.

upgrades.text: Spend **4 Charges** to increase the damage Dice Tier Dice Tier by **+1** each.
Enemies failing the Save who are already Blinded lose 1 turn of Blind and become **Stunned** for 1 turn.

spells.name: Remedial Glow
spells.body: As a **Full Action** create a **3m** diameter AoE pool of warm light within **6m** of you. Any friendly creature that starts their turn in the glow is healed for **1d4** Health, healing is increased by **+1d4** per 15 Light CA. As a **Free Action** you can imbue the glow with **3 Shine Charges** to increase the healing **Dice Tier Count** by **+1** until the start of your next turn. Remedial Glow lasts up to 5 turns, or until Concentration is broken.

upgrades.text: During your turn spend **1 Shine Charge** to move the glow **2m**.
Once per turn when enemies enter or start their turn within the glow take **1d8** Radiant damage. Damage increases by **+1d8** per 20 Light CA.

spells.name: Illuminate
spells.body: As a **Half** or **Extra Action** shine the area brightly revealing all lurking in the shadows. Choose a point within **8m**, a bright light fills the space with a **6m** radius AoE of that point. This light dispells all magical darkness, and reveals creatures hiding from stealth or by magical means. Additionally, enemies that stay in this light cannot hide or enter stealth, nor can they shroud themselves with magical darkness. Martial and Spell **Attack rolls** against enemies within the light get **+2**. Illuminate lasts 3 turns, or until Concentration is broken.

upgrades.text: The first attack each round against each enemy is made with **Advantage**. This resets during your turn instead at the start of round.

Spend **Shine Charges** to empower Illuminate when cast:
- 2 Charges increases the Attack roll bonus by **+1** each.
- 3 Charges to increase the **AC** and **Spell AC** by **+1** for yourself and all allies within the light.

spells.name: Spotlight
spells.body: As a **Half Action**, shine a beam of light above a enemy illuminating them forcing an **AGI** save. Creatures that fail the save take **2d6** Radiant damage, or half on pass. Damage increases by **+1d6** per 10 Light CA and every 3 Player Levels. If they fail the save, until the start of your next turn Spotlight follows them and all attacks against the creature are made with **Advantage**. If they teleports at least 3m away, or successfully enters Stealth or magical darkness, Spotlight is dispelled entirely. Spotlight is a *Weak Debuff* and a creature can only be affected by one Spotlight at a time.

upgrades.text:
Spend Shine Charges to improve the effects of Spotlight:
- 2 Charges to extend the **duration** of Spotlight by **1 turn** each.
- 2 Charges to make the creature **Blind** while under the spotlight. +1 turn of Blind per 2 Charges spent after.
- 3 Charges to increase the damage **Dice Tier Dice Tier** by **+1**.
Creatures affected by Spotlight cannot enter Stealth, invisible or enter magical darkness anymore, and they are revealed when failing the AGI save.

signatureSpells.name: Light Protect Thee
signatureSpells.body: As a **Full Action** target yourself or an ally within **6m**, enshrouding them in bright light. All Melee attacks made against them are made with **Disadvantage**, and all Ranged Martial and Spell Attack rolls get a **-6** penalty. Light Protect Thee lasts up to 3 turns, or when you break Concentration. If an enemy within **8m** successfully hits the protected target, they must make a **DEX** save or take **1d8** Radiant Damage or half on pass. Damage increases by **+1d8** per 15 Light CA, and at Warden Levels 4, 6, 8 and 10.

upgrades.text: Spend **3 Shine Charges** to target a **another** creature with Light Protect Thee, *+1 Mana Cost per each creature protected .*
Enemies that fail the **DEX** save also become **Blinded** for 1 turn. Blind duration increases by **+1** turn at Warden Levels 5 and 8.
